solutions.title: Set cancellation
solutions.strategy: Toggle each value in a set so duplicate values cancel out and the final set contains the answer.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each array value performs one average-case set operation.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The set can hold up to half of the array values before cancellations finish.

solutions.title: XOR cancellation
solutions.strategy: XOR all values; paired values cancel to zero and leave the lone value.
